name: filesystem
description: Filesystem MCP server for MammothOS. Gives Mammoth Mind read/write access to the repo so it can inspect structure, read files, and propose edits through the agent runtime.
notes: Repo root is the allowed root. No paths outside the project are accessible.
Secrets (.env, .env.admin) are in the denied list — the MCP server will refuse those reads.
Write operations should go through human approval gate before commit.
